definition: The dread of the empty prompt box; stage fright before an infinitely capable audience of one.
in_use: Twenty minutes of blankfright — then I just typed what I’d say to a colleague.
the_case: It records a surprising discovery: talking to machines has revived one of the oldest human fears, the blank page — now with something watching.
seo_title: blankfright — the dread of the empty AI prompt box
seo_description: The box is empty and could answer anything. Blankfright names the dread of the empty prompt box: stage fright before an infinitely capable audience of one.
